name: Bala Ged Skyclave
description: A kor skyclave toppled by an elf rebellion, now risen to the sky again.

description_citations.text: "Bala Ged". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The elves of Bala Ged, led by the pre-spirit Obuun, revolt against their kor rulers and topple their Skyclave.
timeline.quote: The elves of Bala Ged, led by a pre-spirit Obuun , revolted against their kor rulers and toppled their Skyclave .

citation.text: "Bala Ged", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Bala Ged becomes a home of nightmares and horrors and its Skyclave rises again; it slowly recovers after Nissa uses the Lithoform Core.
timeline.quote: After Nissa Revane 's use of the healing power of the Lithoform Core , the continent slowly recovers.
